features.name: Bee Bond
features.description: At 2nd level, gain proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth. You can speak/understand Bee Dance. Bees refuse to attack you. When a poison-dealing beast attacks you, it makes CHA save or has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until its next turn.

features.name: Bee Stinger
features.description: At 2nd level, expend one Wild Shape use as action to grow a stinger. Unarmed strikes use WIS: 1d4 + WIS mod piercing + half prof bonus poison damage. Lasts half druid level hours. Scales: 1d6 at L6, 1d8 at L10, 1d10 at L14. Magical from L6.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: At 2nd level, learn true strike. Circle spells at L3/5/7/9: blur/bombardment of stings, fly/haste, giant insect/locate creature, insect plague/telepathic bond. Always prepared.

features.name: Bumblebee Rush
features.description: At 6th level, Dash as bonus action; creatures have disadvantage on attacks against you until your next turn. Prof bonus uses/long rest.

payload.name: Bumblebee Rush
payload.description: Dash as bonus action; attackers have disadvantage until your next turn.

features.name: Hive Mind
features.description: At 10th level, telepathic bond grants linked creatures advantage on INT/WIS/CHA checks if one is proficient. Shared Perception/Insight successes. Advantage on attacks if another linked creature assists.

features.name: Mantle of Bees
features.description: At 14th level, cover yourself in bees for 1 hour: +2 AC, advantage on Intimidation. Melee attackers within 5 ft take 1d8 piercing + 1d8 poison and are poisoned (CON save). Can direct bees to swarm 10-ft radius (4d6 piercing + 4d6 poison, CON save). 1/short or long rest (or 5th+ slot).
